# nicegui

Tiny zero-dependency formatter that inserts a newline after every period.

## Install

```bash
npm install nicegui
```

## Usage

```js
const { periodNewline } = require("nicegui");

periodNewline("One. Two. Three.");
// "One.\nTwo.\nThree.\n"
```

## CLI

```bash
echo "One. Two." | nicegui
```

Output:

```text
One.
Two.
```
